preview.overview: BYU travels to UCF with the College Football Belt on the line in this matchup between two programs with recent history. The Knights are seeking to reclaim the belt they last held in 2014, while the Cougars look to extend their grip on the lineal championship.
key_matchups: BYU's offensive consistency against UCF's defensive vulnerabilities—the Cougars have scored at least 24 points in all five recent games, while UCF has allowed 42 to Oklahoma State and 27 to Houston
UCF's ability to generate explosive plays on offense, as shown in the 44-30 win over Georgia State, against a BYU defense that has held opponents to 24 or fewer points in three of its last five games
The battle in the trenches, with BYU coming off a 41-23 road win at Colorado State and UCF seeking consistency after losses to ranked programs
preview.betting_angles: BYU's recent form is pristine—five straight wins with a low of 17 points and a high of 41. UCF has alternated results dramatically, with only one win in its last five games. The all-time series favors BYU at 4-1, and the Cougars have won the last two meetings by scores of 41-21 and 37-24, both decisive margins. UCF's lone recent offensive explosion came against Georgia State at 44-30, a significantly weaker opponent than BYU.
preview.prediction_writeup: BYU's consistency and pedigree in this series make them the clear favorite to retain the belt. The Cougars have won four of the last five meetings, including dominant victories of 41-21 and 37-24 in 2025 and 2024 respectively. UCF's recent form is uneven—alternating wins and losses with only one victory in the last five games—while BYU has strung together five consecutive wins with balanced offensive production. UCF showed offensive firepower against Georgia State with 44 points, but BYU's defense held Notre Dame to 24 and Iowa State to 10, suggesting the Cougars can contain the Knights' attack. The belt stays in Provo.
